meta.title: refactor: split gradle check into matrix jobs
meta.body_summary: Split the monolithic Gradle check CI job into parallel matrix jobs (compile, spotbugs, unit tests, integration tests) to improve build feedback and reduce redundant task execution.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/gradle.yml, replaced the monolithic Gradle check job with a matrix strategy that runs compile, spotbugs, unit-tests, and integration-tests as separate parallel jobs with exclusions to avoid redundancy; in build.gradle, disabled SpotBugs from the check task and added KSP task dependencies.
change_trajectory: Initial commit split gradle.yml into matrix jobs and adjusted build.gradle.
Subsequent commits fixed YAML formatting, Prettier formatting, and KSP task dependencies.
